title: Kumbh Mela
metaDescription: Kumbh Mela: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Religion.

overview.about: The Kumbh Mela is the largest peaceful gathering of people on Earth - a Hindu pilgrimage where tens of millions bathe at sacred river confluences to wash away sin. Rotating between four holy cities on a roughly 12-year cycle, the full Maha Kumbh can draw crowds numbered in the hundreds of millions.
overview.nextEvent: The next Kumbh Mela gathering brings pilgrims to a sacred river site on the traditional astrological calendar. The largest bathing days see enormous, tightly organised crowds move through temporary tent cities built along the riverbanks.
